details.detail: Overall massing is still right. The 2-4-2 blocks, reclined backs, navy flaps, aisle shrouds, 0.12 consoles with light-grey cup trays and the leg rests read as the ZIM seat in p13a, q14, p14c and st/p3. The side view (st/p7) still matches py_37303. The shell top was widened as asked, but the ds widths at 0.925/0.935 (0.41/0.32, half 0.205/0.16) are still narrower than the wing pads' outer edge (x 0.195 + 0.05, rotated 18 deg, about 0.25). So the arch shoulders still do not cover them.

Rear view: the screen framing and housing are good (p15back against san_05 and san_13). The wing pads still show from behind as white-speckled lumps above and outside the top corners on every seat, most obviously at the aisle-side top corner of the near seat and between adjacent seats (p15back crop). They are smaller than in w3 but clearly present. There is a new visible artefact: a grey tapered cylinder about 7 cm long sticks straight out of the shell side at about y 0.80 (q14 at 650,265 on the window seat ahead, and the top-right corner of each shell in p15back). It is the coat-hook bullet (on(0.80,0.03,0.20)) or the gooseneck boss at x 0.265, sitting beyond the 0.2625 half-width of the shell. Nothing like it appears in san_05, san_13 or alv_02.

Fabric: the blotches are gone and the herringbone direction matches alv_09 and alv_02. Contrast is in range (p13a back p10/p90 90/177; p14c 91/157 against alv_04 125/209). The motif is now too regular and too graphic. It is identical cream rice-grain strokes of one size in neat chevron columns, so at seat distance it reads as a printed leaf wallpaper (p13a, x2/p14c, st/p7). The real fabric (alv_04, alv_09) has irregular cream flecks of mixed size on a blue-grey ground. They cluster into soft lighter diagonal drifts, and the ground has a slight blue-lilac cast. The model is neutral grey (135,133,132).

Headrest: the flap colour, size and hem are good, and the goosenecks match alv_04 and py_37305. The wings are still two separate upright sausages. In alv_04 they are the rounded ends of one wide headrest pad under the flap. Their flecks are now elongated, but on a darker grey ground than the back (94,96,97 against 112,110,109). In alv_04 the headrest and the back are the same tone.

Centre console front: the triangles are now correct. They are right-angled, top-left on the upper cubby and top-right on the lower, royal blue, matching alv_09. The sockets and red tab are right. The cubbies are still flat plates under a black slot. In alv_09 each is an open U-tray whose curved rim wraps round a visible inner back wall, and the upper one fills nearly the whole console width. This is acceptable at normal viewing distance.
Shroud caps are now mid slate-grey (#5c6068) and read correctly against py_37301 and py_37302, with the console lid kept dark as in san_06. Verified.

Seat-back lower half: the pocket is flatter, with a tray lip and a panel. The mesh is still a big dark trapezoid about 0.13 tall that fills most of the panel (st/p2, p6). In alv_05 the mesh window is a shallow wide slot (about 0.30 x 0.07) inside a clearly visible stitched grey panel border. The upper rigid tray is a deep wide tray that spans the whole shell width. The footrest now has one off-centre arm, which is verified. The new diagonal leg struts are champagne or tan (#bdb298) and read almost wood-coloured next to the silver footrest (st/p2, p6). In san_05 and alv_05 the leg frame and strut are cool silver or aluminium.

Bottle bin: it is floor-standing, the right size, and has a placard. The cup tops are now mid-dark grey rather than black, but they still read as two flat dark lids. A #3a3d40 box sits at 0.4425, above the #8a8e92 floor at 0.4405, and covers it. In alv_05 and alv_07 the cups are open light-grey wells with thin walls and a light interior.

issues.detail: Headrest wings still show over the shell arch from behind
issues.problem: The shell's top sections are narrower than the wing pads' outer edge. At 0.925 the shell half-width is 0.205 and at 0.935 it is 0.16, while the wings reach about 0.25 at y 0.72-0.92. Speckled lumps are visible at the top corners in p15back.
issues.evidence: w4r/p15back.png (crop at the top corners) vs ref/web/py/san_05, alv_03
issues.fix: 09b_py.js l.32-33: keep the shell square-shouldered up to wing height, for example ...[0.88,0.075,0.525],[0.905,0.068,0.52],[0.925,0.055,0.50],[0.94,0.035,0.44],[0.948,0.015,0.30]. Or pull the wings in (l.41: x 0.195 -> 0.175, rotation 18 -> 12 deg) and cap their top at 0.90 (last SEC 0.92 -> 0.90). Verify from the p15back camera that no speckle shows.

issues.detail: Grey stub sticking out of the shell side
issues.problem: A tapered grey cylinder about 7 cm long pokes horizontally out of the shell side at about y 0.80 and hangs in mid-air (q14, p15back). It comes from the coat-hook bullet (gCyl 0.012-0.016 x 0.07 at on(0.80,0.03,0.20), rotated to lie along x) and/or the gooseneck boss at x 0.265.
issues.evidence: w4r/q14_seat26A.png at (650,265), w4r/p15back.png top-right of each shell
issues.fix: l.119: orient the coat hook along the shell normal (z), not x, so it points aft from the back face, or shorten it to 0.035 and set dx 0.16 so it sits inside the shell outline. Move the gooseneck boss (l.126) to x 0.25 so it is flush with the shell side.

issues.detail: Fabric motif too uniform and graphic
issues.problem: Identical rice-grain strokes in neat chevron columns read as a leaf print. The real fabric has irregular mixed-size cream flecks that gather into soft diagonal drifts on a blue-grey ground.
issues.fix: make_swatches.py / the py_back tile: randomise stroke length (x0.4-1.6), width and angle jitter (+-15 deg), drop about 30 % of the strokes in random low-frequency zones so lighter and darker diagonal drifts appear (large scale, low amplitude: +-8 % luminance, not the old dark blotches), and shift the ground slightly blue (about (118,122,132)). Keep p10/p90.

issues.problem: The dark mesh trapezoid (0.07-0.20) fills the panel. The real mesh is a shallow wide window in a stitched border, under a deep full-width tray.
issues.fix: l.109: replace the loft with gBox(0.30,0.065,0.003) at on(0.12,0.019) in grille, add a thin lighter stitch line round it, and make the tray lip (l.107) 0.46 wide x 0.05 tall so it spans the shell.

issues.problem: #bdb298 reads as tan or wood beside the silver footrest.

issues.detail: Bottle-bin cups read as closed lids
issues.problem: The dark #3a3d40 box sits above the lighter floor and caps each cell.
issues.fix: l.180: delete the #3a3d40 box or move it about 5 cm lower (a shadowed bottom), and add four thin pyBin walls rising 0.01 above the bin top round each cell.

issues.detail: Wing pads darker than the back and separate
issues.problem: The wings are separate sausages, darker than the back fabric (94 against 112). In the photos they are rounded ends of one headrest pad in the same tone.
issues.fix: Raise the pyWing base colour to about the back's mean and let the headrest loft (l.37) widen to 0.46 at 0.72-0.87, so the wings merge into it rather than standing proud with a crease.

questionsForUser: Fabric motif: should the SFO-NRT aircraft follow ANA's official dash weave (py_37305) or the 2026 Alviator fleck-drift pattern (alv_04 / alv_09)? The current tile sits between the two.
